title: SDK 12.0
summary: SDK 12.0 makes our Next.js, React, Vite, Node.js and NestJS SDKs more reliable.
body_markdown:
We’ve released SDK 12.0, an update across our Next.js, React, Vite, Node.js and NestJS SDKs focused on reliability.


Source maps and release data now publish more dependably, so investigations work from your real source code instead of minified output. Consent choices carry through the SDK consistently, so analytics and session replay respect what your users picked. The SDKs also now run on the latest OpenTelemetry releases.
